result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback position by retaining annual automatic renewals while reducing the non-renewal deadline from 90 to 30 days, well within the 60-day maximum. It makes only the changes needed, preserves the bilateral renewal structure and 12-month renewal term, and appropriately clarifies that the notice is one of non-renewal. No price-increase language existed in the original clause, so no existing increase right required capping.
